residency_notes: Cohere documents stronger data-handling commitments and private deployment options for enterprise customers, but the reviewed public SaaS API materials do not establish a default execution/data region or a generally available Zero Data Retention control.
prompt_training_notes: Cohere says enterprise SaaS customers can opt out of prompts and generations being used to train Cohere models, and private/VPC partner deployments keep customer inputs and outputs outside Cohere-managed training flows.

sources.notes: Official OpenAI compatibility endpoint and Chat/Embeddings parameter contract.

verification.notes: Verified the compatibility endpoint, bearer authentication, production Chat, Embeddings and Rerank routes, and the native v2 Parse route. Parse is available as free, rate-limited evaluation access because Cohere has not published a production API rate.
